root_goal: Evidence-complete pre-implementation research for RICON on Arma Reforger

q_000.text: Does the combined evidence justify beginning implementation under the approved constraints?
q_000.answer: Reciprocal research is complete, but canonical target and Workshop license must be decided before code is unfrozen.

q_001.text: Are product scope, source-of-truth artifacts, versions, and prohibited actions complete and internally consistent?
q_001.answer: Yes for research; implementation source location and license remain owner decisions.

q_002.text: Which public VoN delivery/radio controls exist, and which authority and replication semantics still require source or runtime proof?
q_002.answer: Public controls are cross-verified; runtime authority/latency remain blocked.

q_003.text: Can a normal Workshop mod dynamically bind RICON per-link quality to audible VoN effects?
q_003.answer: No pair-specific binding was found by either agent.

q_004.text: What do RelayTransceiver and IntercomTransceiver actually do, and can they satisfy leak-free radio-network relay semantics?
q_004.answer: Both agents confirm type existence only; CoverageRadio is not proof of voice forwarding.

q_005.text: What replication, JIP, streaming, authority, and lifecycle primitives constrain the server-authoritative design?
q_005.answer: Authority primitives are verified; far-radio streaming and snapshot partition remain unresolved.

q_006.text: What is the supported no-Play Workbench addon structure, compilation workflow, and source/resource visibility?
q_006.answer: Game data is installed; a separate read-only Workbench SOURCE session and compile check remain.

q_007.text: Is reverse engineering permitted under the current official Tools EULA?
q_007.answer: No. RE is blocked absent explicit written Bohemia permission or a qualified legal determination.

q_008.text: Which HDSP layers are standards-grounded, which are heuristics, and what calibration evidence is still required?
q_008.answer: Cross-audit rejects A3 Epstein-Peterson and VHF/UHF rain as automatic production defaults; current P.526 version and calibration remain open.

q_009.text: What measured budgets and candidate-culling strategy can support 30-player acceptance and 60-player stress?
q_009.answer: Static culling APIs and arithmetic are verified; runtime budgets remain blocked.

q_010.text: Are the common core contracts and extension registries sufficient for radio, infrastructure, and later cellular use without core rewrites?
q_010.answer: ScriptedRadioComponent is a valid extension point; executable contract coverage remains absent.

q_011.text: Which checks are allowed now, and what remains blocked?
q_011.answer: Research/static/source/compile work is allowed after decisions; runtime/audio/multiplayer remain blocked.

q_012.text: Are M3a subscriber, attach, SMS, service-code, and M3b voice/handover semantics complete, private, bounded, and honestly labeled?
q_012.answer: Standards and PersistenceSystem candidates are cross-verified; runtime semantics remain open.

q_013.text: What can be learned from TFAR, ACRE2, Coalition VON, and Lima Charlie without copying incompatible or unlicensed code?
q_013.answer: Behavior/architecture/failure modes only under current clean-room policy.

q_014.text: Are packaging, licensing, versioning, rollback, observability, and support requirements complete?
q_014.answer: Workshop license is blocked; BattlEye and operational implementation remain open.

q_015.text: Has Claude independently audited the Codex dossier and published source-backed corrections for every coverage section?
q_015.answer: Yes: agora ids 354-361; Codex responded ids 362-365; Claude accepted corrections id366.

q_016.text: Can script-set entity/global audio signals reach the vanilla VoN SoundComponent for a specific received transmission?

q_017.text: Can a Workshop addon safely override or extend vanilla VON ACP/SIG resources without global conflicts?

q_018.text: How does the absence of BaseSoundComponent on dedicated servers constrain policy/audio ownership?
q_018.answer: Server policy and client audio presentation must remain separate.

q_019.text: How can far-radio participants remain relevant without globally forcing expensive Rpl streaming?

q_020.text: Which state belongs in owner-only snapshots versus replicated entities or RPCs for JIP-safe radio lifecycle?

q_021.text: Does the current Arma Reforger Tools EULA allow a narrow reverse-engineering exception?

q_022.text: What primary standard and exact version governs each HDSP layer and parameter?
q_022.answer: P.526-15 delta-Bullington evidence exists; current P.526-16 and other layers need exact version review.

q_023.text: Which measured or published datasets will calibrate materials, clutter, weather, intelligibility, and uncertainty?

q_024.text: What synthetic workload, frame budget, cache bound, and Rpl budget define acceptance before runtime measurements?

q_025.text: What exact SMS queue lifetime, persistence, capacity, retry, dedupe, and privacy semantics are required?
q_025.answer: PersistenceSystem is a candidate; exact policy remains a design decision.

q_026.text: How will the USSD-like service-code request and SMS response be labeled as a gameplay abstraction rather than 3GPP parity?
q_026.answer: As USSD-inspired ServiceRequest with SMS response transport.

q_027.text: Which owner/legal-approved license path permits Workshop distribution without violating the current GPLv3 or Workshop restrictions?

q_028.text: Does the owner confirm the clean new RICON-Reforger repository as the sole canonical implementation target?
q_028.answer: Both agents recommend yes; the Codex legacy worktree should remain research scratch.
